title: BG - Battle Games
description: BG – Battle Games V1 is a Minecraft arena plugin where players fight, gain or lose lives, collect items, and survive in a shrinking arena. After 20 minutes, the player with the most lives wins.
body:
Features:
- Every player starts with **7 lives**.
- When a player dies, they lose one life – the killer gains one.
- At **1 heart**, lives can no longer be taken away.
- The arena continuously shrinks, forcing players closer together.
- After **20 minutes**, the player with the most lives wins!
- Start a match with `/bg start <time in minutes>`
- Check your current lives with `/lives`

Perfect for servers that want thrilling and tactical battles.

**Keywords**: Minecraft, Plugin, Battle Arena, PVP, Survival, Mini Game, Lives System, Shrinking Arena, Food Drops, Custom Rules, Multiplayer, Combat, Game Mode, BG, Battle Games
